mapper.insert: INSERT INTO avidity_alarm_stat (stat_date, virtual_device_id, device_name, alarm_name, alarm_content, alarm_count, synced_at) VALUES (#{statDate}, #{virtualDeviceId}, #{deviceName}, #{alarmName}, #{alarmContent}, #{alarmCount}, #{syncedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE alarm_content = VALUES(alarm_content), alarm_count = VALUES(alarm_count), device_name = VALUES(device_name), synced_at = VALUES(synced_at)
